interpretation_boundary: These are independent, host-PDC-compensated exports of one installed E2Deesser VST3 instance over a deterministic 72-second composite arrangement. The evidence isolates Solo Vocal versus Voice Over with otherwise default controls; Auto 100% with Smooth held at 50%; Smooth 100% with Auto held at 50%; and a deliberately extreme Auto/Smooth endpoint contrast while Sensitivity, Amount, Gain and Dry/Wet remain fixed. Because Dry/Wet is 50%, measured attenuation is not a fully wet ceiling. Auto and Smooth were changed together in opposite directions, so their comparison establishes endpoint behavior rather than an additive transfer function for either control in isolation. The fixture is not an annotated speech corpus; results do not establish detection recall or preference across singers, languages, microphones or consonant classes. Alternate modes, custom EQ curves, automation, CPU use and listening preference remain outside this test.
